title: Last Gate
brief: Top-down tower defense: click a marked pad to build a turret for 10 gold, then survive five waves of enemies walking a fixed path. GameState keeps gold, towers, wave, leaks and won. Enemies that reach the exit add a leak; ten leaks lose the run; clearing wave five sets won.
artDirection: Moody stone gate at dusk, bright turret muzzles and enemy outlines, gold and leak counters legible at a glance, clear build pads.

obligations.description: Clicking a build pad places a turret and raises towers.
Building a turret lowers gold from its starting fifty.
An enemy reaching the gate adds a leak.
Clearing the fifth wave wins the defence.
Building on an occupied pad is rejected and costs no gold.
obligations.unsupported: The vocabulary has no negative route or invariance check; rejecting a build and leaving gold untouched is the opposite of the changes it can prove.

obligations.description: Each wave's composition is fixed by the run seed, so the same seed sends the same enemies.
obligations.unsupported: Wave composition is a list of enemy identities, and repeatability needs two runs compared under one seed; the probe reads scalars and the vocabulary has no seed identity.
